objective: Repair only evidenced Round 05 valuation timing, package identity, and confidentiality vocabulary failures without expanding valuation or approval authority.

changes.design: Add source-bearing, human-confirmed per-period discount_exponent inputs. Use them directly for explicit FCFF and terminal-value discounting and disclose their basis and values in calculation output and UI.
changes.fail_closed: A confirmed DCF without complete explicit exponents may calculate only under the narrow legacy compatibility rule; all other missing, partial, non-positive, non-increasing, or scenario-conflicting timing sets hard fail.
changes.candidate_boundary: Candidate timing inputs remain candidate_input and cannot calculate or confirm themselves.

changes.design: Refresh the local editable installation from already-correct 0.5.0 source metadata and add a regression that detects installed/source version drift when distribution metadata is present.
Accept internal_only as an input alias and persist the existing canonical confidentiality value internal.

compatibility_rule.explicit_path: A complete, source-bearing exponent for every period in every DCF scenario is accepted for any valuation date; exponent sequences must be identical across scenarios, positive, and strictly increasing.
compatibility_rule.legacy_path: Positional period-end exponents 1..N remain available only when the valuation date is December 31 and every scenario supplies confirmed structured period_end dates equal to consecutive December 31 year ends starting one year later.
compatibility_rule.forbidden_inference: Period labels such as FY2027E are never parsed or guessed as dates.
compatibility_rule.candidate_path: Incomplete company candidate timing may be stored for review but cannot be calculated or converted to confirmed input without satisfying the explicit or legacy rule.

negative_regressions: confirmed non-year-end DCF without exponents is rejected
old confirmed stored inputs cannot bypass the calculation-time timing gate
partial, non-positive, non-increasing, and cross-scenario-conflicting exponents fail closed
free-text period labels cannot activate legacy compatibility
candidate exponents remain non-calculable until human confirmation
positive_regressions: explicit 1.5/2.5/3.5 exponents are used and disclosed deterministically
validated December-31 annual sequence retains positional 1/2/3 compatibility
runtime package metadata matches source version after environment refresh
non_goals: investment, credit, or aggregate risk rating
automatic import or confirmation of company supplement assumptions
